run_keyboard_teleop_client: run the KeyboardTeleoperationClient to start keyboard-based teleoperation of a LoCoBot robot
create_keyboard_teleop_client: create a KeyboardTeleoperationClient instance that publishes keyboard commands to the ROS teleoperation topic
review_keyboard_teleop_client_init: review the KeyboardTeleoperationClient init method that loads teleop.yaml config and creates a ROS publisher
review_keyboard_teleop_client_run: review the KeyboardTeleoperationClient run method that reads keyboard input and publishes commands in a loop
test_keyboard_teleop_client_exit: test the KeyboardTeleoperationClient exit method that logs an exit message and calls sys.exit
